offering_description.value: Provides payment processing, electronic transaction and banking technology services to banks, merchants and government agencies, mainly in Puerto Rico, the Caribbean and Latin America. It runs transaction networks and processing platforms and earns fees for each transaction processed and for outsourced IT and operations work.

primary_products.value: payment processing platforms; ATH-style debit network; point-of-sale terminals; banking software

primary_services.value: transaction processing; merchant acquiring; IT outsourcing; business process outsourcing

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit unions, merchants and other financial institutions; B2G: Puerto Rico government agencies paying or collecting through its platforms

end_markets.value: financial services; retail; government; healthcare; hospitality

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-transaction fees for payments processed on its networks and platforms; service fees: outsourced IT, operations and business process services; licensing or royalties: software licenses for banking and payment systems; product sales: point-of-sale terminals and related hardware sold to merchants
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; licensing or royalties; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs payment processing and outsourced operations for banks and merchants; software / platform: operates payment platforms and sells banking software to financial institutions; financial intermediary: merchant acquiring that routes card and debit payments between merchants and banks
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: Puerto Rico, United States, Caribbean, Central America and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: payment processing, banking software, merchant services and IT outsourcing sharing bank and merchant customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to banks and large merchants; partners / resellers: partner banks and technology resellers in Latin America and the Caribbean

regulatory_exposure.value: high: payment processing and banking services under banking regulators and card network and data security rules

notes: Geographic scope and product mix are based on general knowledge and may have changed.
